name: sandbox-create-bad-metadata
about: A label no target would keep is refused before anything starts.

response.error: the metadata name "sandhold-org" is reserved for the node
response.fix: use at most 16 labels; a name and a value are letters, digits, dashes, underscores and dots (at most 63, starting and ending with a letter or digit), and a name does not start with sandhold-
